subject: mathematics
instructions: Work independently. Show the mathematical steps or representation that support each response.
Check each result before submitting. A response without the requested work may require adult review.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain division models in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of partial quotients.
Apply standard division strategies in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving remainders in context; correct it and explain why.
Connect division models with two-rule numerical patterns. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Design a fair distribution plan and explain how the meaning of remainders changes by context.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated accuracy or fidelity criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated evidence and reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated application or performance criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated checking and revision criterion.
